VHist - Fit STR history to new timestamps.vi

Owning Palette: History Report & Utility VIs

The VI looks over String history and determines history values at the new time stamps specified. New time stamps can be specified either in new time stamps array or time conditions cluster defining initial and final timestamps, and time step. By default, VI replaces absent values with an empty string and merges values located between adjacent new time stamps. Either of these features can be suppressed.

Click the parameters for more information

 

new time stamps. Array of new timestamps historical data need be fitted to.
time stamps. Array of timestamps for respective elements in history data.
history data. Array of historical values.
time condition cluster specifies parameters to generate new array of time stamps.
From defines initial timestamp of a time range.
To defines final timestamp of a time range.
step, sec defines time interval.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
empty for absent (T). If TRUE (by default), the VI outputs empty string for absent values. If FALSE, the VI uses the last known value.
merge data (T). If TRUE, the VI merges values comming in between adjacent new time stamps; otherwise, it uses the last known value.
time stamps out. Array of new timestamps to which historical data are fitted.
history data out. Array of historical values fitted to new timestamps in the time stamps out.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
